name: Globl Radio
extends: All Grounds Floating (../agf-design-system/agf-design-system/tokens.json). Every token not listed here is AGF's, unchanged, in all three themes.

color.note: Air is Globl Radio's native theme (the player and anything running while a performance is on). Midnight for the site and portal. Daylight for printed tickets and press.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: AGF's signal-clip promoted to the sub-brand's second voice. Fills the ON AIR lamp, the live ring, the play control while on air. Only where something is live now.

tokens.name: live-glow
tokens.usage: The lit state of live: hover on the live play control, the lamp's bright phase.

tokens.name: live-text
tokens.usage: The word live, the live time in a schedule, the countdown at zero. Holds 4.5:1 on surface in every theme.

tokens.name: live-hairline
tokens.usage: A live trace or border, used only beside live content.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on a live fill. Never white in Midnight or Air.

tokens.name: shadow-live
tokens.usage: The glow of a lit live lamp or solid ON AIR badge. Nothing else glows red.

tokens.name: opacity-stave
tokens.usage: The stave's opacity over surface-deep (Midnight, Air) or over bone (Daylight).

tokens.name: stave-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between the five lines of a stave. Fixed at every width.

tokens.name: stave-group
tokens.usage: Distance between staves when tiled. 48px under 640px.

marks.clear_space: one ring width on every side
